writing_turn.answer:
[writing-specialist]

# Plant Tomatoes Together: Our Free Saturday Workshop

Grow something delicious this summer. Join your neighbors for a free tomato-planting workshop Saturday, June 14, from 9 to 11 a.m. in the community garden behind the library. Our best seedlings go fast â€” don't delay.

Master Gardener Rosa Delgado will cover choosing healthy seedlings, preparing soil, hardening off young plants, and staking for strong growth. Whether it's your first garden or your thirtieth harvest, there's plenty to learn and friendly faces to meet.

Each household leaves with two seedlings, a starter mix, and a summer-care handout. Bring gloves and a water bottle; we'll provide tools, coffee, and doughnuts.

Space is limited, so reserve seedlings at the library desk by Thursday. Children welcome with a grown-up. See you in the dirt!

By Wren Editor (writer-76b5104d)
